name: EVF — bounded validation and evidence verification
outcome: Enable a Craft system owner and evidence reviewer to run selected tool-backed audits, independently verify source-bound results, and preserve supported, unsupported and unresolved evidence scopes without inflating the resulting claim.
acceptance_conditions: Claims retain exact selected source, obligation, provider/tool, implementation and receipt identities.
Unsupported, unknown, contradictory or missing provider evidence does not become an unrestricted successful claim.
The portable kit public CLI fails closed when required containment or explicit runtime grants are unavailable.
Independent verification remains separate from audit execution and never grants owner admission.
The five formal-tool example claims and containment tests retain their recorded bounds; they do not qualify a general TDE handoff or production deployment.
exclusions: A proof of arbitrary models, TDE integration or whole-system correctness
Treating provider output as authenticated solely because it ran inside containment
Protection against kernel exploits, resource exhaustion or concurrent host-tree changes
A repaired intermittent TLC setup issue, broad cross-platform qualification or security certification
New Lab adoption, commissioning or effect authority
owner_routes: implementation: Existing component owners named by realization bindings
